fun_facts: Bhayshul Tuten was born in Paulsboro, New Jersey.
As a child, Bhayshul Tuten played track and field and wrestled.
At Virginia Tech, Bhayshul Tuten set a school rushing record with 266 yards in one game, and scored four touchdowns against Boston College.
Bhayshul Tuten played two college seasons at North Carolina A&T before Virginia Tech. Across his college career, he rushed for 3,600 yards and 41 touchdowns, and scored nine receiving touchdowns.
Bhayshul Tuten ran the 40-yard dash in 4.32 seconds, the fastest time among players at his position at the event and sixth-fastest overall.

excerpts:
[Bhayshul Tuten](https://www.jaguars.com/team/players-roster/bhayshul-tuten/ "Bhayshul Tuten") , a running back from Virginia Tech, on Saturday was selected by the Jaguars No. 104 overall in the [2025 NFL Draft](https://www.jaguars.com/draft/) – the second selection of Round 4.

Tuten, a senior who played at North Carolina A&T for two seasons before playing two seasons at Virginia Tech, rushed for 3,600 career yards and 41 touchdowns. He averaged 5.99 yards per carry for his career and also scored nine receiving touchdowns.

He rushed for 1,159 yards and 15 touchdowns last season in 2024. He was a second-team All-Atlantic Coast Conference selection the past two seasons.

Tuten became the third player from Virginia Tech selected by the Jaguars in the NFL Draft, the first since wide
